details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook (node beacon.cjs) — and its index.js entry point, which calls the same beacon on import — sends a single JSON POST of install metadata to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. The reported fields are limited to the package name, hostname, install path (__dirname), working directory, and the npm user the publisher string. It reads no environment variables, credentials, tokens, or files, spawns no processes, and loads no second stage; index.js exports a no-op Proxy shim so imports do not fail. The README describes the package as published for an authorized dependency-confusion test that only reports that it was installed.
